chunks: God is certainly the great provider, Lord of strength and power.

key_terms.الرَّزَّاقُ: The Provider, The One who gives sustenance
key_terms.الْمَتِينُ: The Strong, The Enduring, The Firm

ai.seo_question: What does it mean that God is Ar-Razzaq and Dhul-Qawwal-Matin?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to emphasize that divine provision (rizq) is not merely material but is sustained by God's unyielding, structural power (quwwah), ensuring stability for all creation. The attribute 'Al-Matin' (The Firm/Strong) underscores the reliability of God's sustenance, reassuring believers that their livelihood is anchored in His eternal, unshakeable might rather than transient worldly forces.
